Which of the following definitions creates a linear combination of the functions $f(x)$ and $g(x)$?

```{mcq}
#| label: lfc-1-kdw
A. $h(x) \equiv f(x) \times g(x)$
B. $h(x) \equiv f(g(x))$
C. $h(x) \equiv a \cdot f(x) + b \cdot g(x)$ [correct]
D. $h(x) \equiv \frac{f(x)}{g(x)}$
```
:::
